queue.title: Two Builders
queue.idea: rock house stands / sand house storm / sand house falls; same builder, same storm

queue.title: The Lost Sheep
queue.idea: shepherd counts 99 / searches in dark / carries the one home on shoulders, joy

queue.title: The Ten Virgins
queue.idea: lamps go out without oil / lamp with flask stays lit / door opens for the ready one

queue.title: The Prodigal Son
queue.idea: son leaves with coin bag / father sees him far off and runs / robe placed on him

queue.title: The Mustard Seed
queue.idea: tiny seed planted / grows into tree / birds nest in its branches

queue.title: Pharisee and Tax Collector
queue.idea: one stands tall boasting / one beats breast far off / the humble one walks home lifted

queue.title: Martha and Mary
queue.idea: Martha rushing between pots / Mary sitting at the feet / Martha sits too

queue.title: The Widow's Mite
queue.idea: rich drop big bags / widow drops two small coins / her coins glow largest

queue.title: Zacchaeus
queue.idea: short man blocked by crowd / climbs sycamore / Jesus stops and looks up

queue.title: The Narrow Gate
queue.idea: crowd streams through wide gate / one squeezes through narrow gate / path beyond opens into light

queue.title: Birds and Lilies
queue.idea: man pacing with worries stacked on his back / birds fed / he sets the load down and sleeps

queue.title: Salt of the Earth
queue.idea: salt that lost flavor tossed out / city on a hill seen from far / people drawn to the light

queue.title: The Unforgiving Servant
queue.idea: king tears up the debt / freed servant chokes his fellow / king's question

queue.title: Lazarus
queue.idea: Jesus weeps at tomb / stone rolled away / Lazarus walks out bound

queue.title: Blind Bartimaeus
queue.idea: beggar calls out / crowd tells him to be silent, he shouts louder / sees and follows

queue.title: The Ten Lepers
queue.idea: ten healed walking away / one turns back / he alone kneels thanking

queue.title: Calming the Storm
queue.idea: waves fill boat / Jesus asleep on cushion / he rises, sea goes still

queue.title: Jonah
queue.idea: Jonah runs the other way by ship / swallowed by fish / walks into Nineveh (check CPDV numbering)

queue.title: David and Goliath
queue.idea: boy picks five stones / giant laughs / stone flies, giant falls (CPDV may call it 1 Kings)

queue.title: Noah's Dove
queue.idea: rain / dove returns with olive leaf / rainbow

queue.title: Crossing the Sea
queue.idea: people trapped at sea / Moses stretches hand / walls of water, walking through

queue.title: The Still Small Voice
queue.idea: wind breaks rocks / fire / whisper, Elijah covers face (check CPDV book naming)

queue.title: The Barren Fig Tree
queue.idea: owner with axe / gardener digs and fertilizes / tree fruits

queue.title: The Vine and Branches
queue.idea: branch cut off withers / attached branch / heavy grapes

queue.title: The Good Shepherd
queue.idea: wolf comes / hired man runs / shepherd stands between wolf and sheep

queue.title: Wheat and Weeds
queue.idea: enemy sows at night / servants want to pull / harvest sorted

queue.title: The Hidden Treasure
queue.idea: man finds treasure / sells everything / buys the field with joy

queue.title: The Two Sons
queue.idea: father asks both / one says no then goes / one says yes then sits

queue.title: Workers in the Vineyard
queue.idea: hired at dawn / hired late / all paid the same coin

queue.title: The Rich Fool
queue.idea: builds bigger barns / sits back to relax / candle goes out at night

queue.title: The Persistent Widow
queue.idea: widow knocks at judge daily / judge ignores / judge finally rises

queue.title: Washing Feet
queue.idea: Jesus removes outer garment / basin, washes feet / disciples wash each other's

queue.title: Peter Restored
queue.idea: rooster crows / fire on the beach / Peter's head lifts, 'Feed my sheep'

queue.title: The Road to Emmaus
queue.idea: two walk sad with stranger / he breaks bread / their hearts burned

queue.title: Five Loaves
queue.idea: boy gives small basket / bread passed out / twelve baskets left

queue.title: Come to Me
queue.idea: man bent under heavy load / takes the yoke beside Jesus / walks light

queue.title: Trust in the Lord
queue.idea: man reads map alone, lost / holds a guiding hand / path straightens

queue.title: The Lord is My Shepherd
queue.idea: Vulgate numbering: Hebrew Psalm 23 is CPDV Psalm 22; green pastures / still waters / dark valley with staff

queue.title: Love Is Patient
queue.idea: waiting / carrying another / three words remain

queue.title: Do Not Be Anxious
queue.idea: worries piling up / kneels in prayer / peace like a guard at the door

queue.title: Faith and Works
queue.idea: cold person / passerby says 'be warm' and leaves / another gives coat

queue.title: Run the Race
queue.idea: runner weighed down / drops the weights / runs, eyes forward

queue.title: Mercies New Every Morning
queue.idea: night / sunrise / same man rises again

queue.title: Do Not Grow Weary
queue.idea: farmer tired / keeps watering / harvest

queue.title: Love Your Enemies
queue.idea: neighbor throws stone / man offers bread / neighbor softens

queue.title: The Annunciation
queue.idea: angel greets / Mary troubled / Mary's yes, light fills room

queue.title: The Wedding at Cana
queue.idea: wine runs out / Mary: do whatever he tells you / water tastes like wine

queue.title: The Woman Who Touched His Cloak
queue.idea: crowd presses / she reaches the hem / he turns, 'your faith has saved you'
